history.summary: AMBIGUOUS IDENTITY - the most likely candidate for this row is the Sitala (Shitala Maa) temple at Sitalabari in the Nadir Par area of Lumding, documented in local tourism sources; Shitala Maa is the goddess invoked against poxes and disease, and her mid-year Sitala Puja draws devotees. No founding date or detailed history is published for this shrine. CSV district/town 'Nagaon' is approximate: Lumding lies in Hojai district, which was carved out of Nagaon district in 2016 - district corrected to Hojai. Coordinates below are approximate Lumding-town coordinates, NOT the temple's exact location.

name: Sitalabari Temple
town_description: Lumding is a major railway junction town in Hojai district, Assam (carved out of Nagaon district in 2016), at the edge of the North Cachar Hills. It is known for its railway colony and clusters of Kalibari and Sitalabari shrines.

travel.airport: Nearest major airport: Guwahati (~185 km, verify)
travel.railway: Lumding Junction - a major Northeast railway junction, in the town
travel.road: NH-27 passes nearby; well connected by road to Nagaon and Hojai

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; mid-year Sitala Puja is the main festival period
